day.name: Palace courtyards. A hilltop ending.
assumptions: One full sightseeing day in Beijing; hotel transfers are not yet planned.
A morning Palace Museum reservation is required for this sample. Suggested windows are not bookings.
No train, hotel, guide or attraction ticket is included.

arrive.title: Find the right gate
arrive.action: Start early enough for the walk to Wumen, security and identity checks. Your hotel and departure point are unknown, so no transfer time is invented.

palace.title: A south-to-north palace visit
palace.action: Enter at Wumen. Follow the signed visitor route through the palace courtyards and gardens towards Shenwumen. Respect the Taihemen works diversion; this is not a guaranteed uninterrupted central-axis walk.

lunch.title: A proper lunch break
lunch.action: Eat after exiting, before the hill climb. Choose a nearby open place that fits your dietary needs; live search results are ideas, not restaurant endorsements.

crossing.title: Shenwumen → Jingshan south gate
crossing.action: Use the signed pedestrian crossing facilities. The buffer is an editorial allowance, not a measured walk. You can check this outdoor leg with Amap below.

jingshan.title: Look back at the city
jingshan.action: Enter Jingshan at the south gate. If conditions suit, climb to Wanchun Pavilion; otherwise keep to the lower paths. Leave the evening open.

bj-palace.name: The Forbidden City
bj-palace.reservation: Book through the Palace Museum official channels. Passport booking is supported. Carry the original document used for the booking. The current summary releases tickets seven days ahead at 20:00 Beijing time; check your date and session.
bj-palace.access: Enter at Wumen (south). Visit northwards and leave at Shenwumen for Jingshan. Normally closed Mondays except statutory holidays; check dated notices. Taihemen has a works notice: follow the on-site diversion.
bj-palace.photography: Courtyards and roof details reward an unhurried look. Follow gallery photography signs; do not assume flash or tripods are permitted.

bj-jingshan.name: Jingshan Park
bj-jingshan.reservation: The newer official FAQ permits on-site purchase, including at the south gate. Online tickets are also available through Changyou Gongyuan. Carry your passport and check date-specific notices.
bj-jingshan.access: Approach the south gate after leaving the Palace Museum at Shenwumen. Use the signed pedestrian crossing. The hilltop viewpoint involves stairs.
bj-jingshan.photography: Wanchun Pavilion looks south over the palace roofs. Clear weather matters; use lower park paths if steps or poor visibility make the climb unsuitable.

card-wumen.title: The way in
card-wumen.caution: Ask for walking directions. Vehicles do not drive to this gate. Confirm a legal drop-off separately.

card-shenwumen.title: The way out
card-shenwumen.caution: Exit only. Do not use this gate to start a Palace Museum visit.

card-jingshan.title: Across to the hill
card-jingshan.caution: Use the signed pedestrian crossing. The park address does not identify a legal taxi stopping point.

reservation.title: Palace morning session booked
reservation.detail: Use the official channel and confirm the date and named traveller. This checkbox records your confirmation, not a booking by us.

passport.title: Original passport ready
passport.detail: Bring the document used for the reservation. Do not upload its number here.

approach.title: Hotel-to-Wumen approach checked
approach.detail: Confirm walking access and a legal drop-off if using a car. Museum address ≠ vehicle entrance.

notice.title: Current closure notices checked
notice.detail: Check Monday exceptions, Taihemen works and date-specific controls before departure.

offline.title: Cards and daybook saved on my phone
offline.detail: Open the downloaded files in flight mode. Saving a checkbox does not download the files.

admission.label: Admission allowance
admission.note: Planning allowance for the two sites; not current ticket prices. Extra exhibitions excluded.

food.label: Lunch, water & a snack
food.note: A casual meal and refreshment allowance, not restaurant quotes.

local.label: Local transport allowance
local.note: Hotel location is unknown; replace this with your actual transfer plan.

0.title: Palace sold out or closed
0.body: Do not travel to Wumen expecting walk-up entry. Switch to a separately checked Jingshan / nearby neighbourhood day, or move the palace visit to a date you can book. This is a replacement day, not the same itinerary.

1.title: Rain, haze or tired legs
1.body: Skip the hilltop climb. Take a longer meal break or choose lower park paths if conditions allow. Do not add an unverified museum booking as a guaranteed fallback.

2.title: A gate or crossing is controlled
2.body: Follow staff directions. Recheck the outdoor route, allow more time and drop the optional hill climb before rushing. An Amap route does not override on-site controls.
